note: PR 3b: the loose-pill radiogroups converge on SegmentedSwitch (kind radio, tone neutral). The three /decks Stats cards' filters (worth order, shared cards, collection cuts) are size compact like the Lineup filter above them; their accent fill is gone. Tuning history's tool chips and Mana Balance's color chips keep the default size (the 44px phone floor) in a well that scrolls sideways at phone, and keep data-history-chip and data-mana-chip. The commanders facet strip is default size and scrolling; its dashed All and accent ring are gone. The admin switches list's Show filter is compact and scrolling. Needs LINEUP_ENABLED=true and an account with several decks (a pull:staging copy) for the Stats rows; ANALYSIS_TAB_ENABLED, TUNING_ENABLED and MANA_BALANCE_ENABLED 'true' and MANA_MULTI_DECK naming a multi-color deck with a Mana Balance run in its history for the hub rows; FACET_COMMANDER_SLUG naming a commander whose synergy panel draws more than one populated facet. The admin row needs a server started with ADMIN_USER_IDS naming the signed-in account and ADMIN_ENV_LABEL staging (see admin.json); the headless account is no admin otherwise, and that row then fails, which is the gate working, not a regression. The fold memory is a cookie, so only stats-worth presses Expand all and the two Stats rows after it find the cards still open; keep the three in that order.
